villager_decorum.settings.title: Villager Decorum Settings
villager_decorum.settings.workstations.t: Lets Villagers sit on Cushions in front of or beside their Workstation. They keep working from there.
villager_decorum.settings.beds.tooltip: Lets Villagers sit on Cushions within 5 blocks of their Bed during free time, or when they have no job.
villager_decorum.settings.bells.tooltip: Lets Villagers sit on Cushions within 10 blocks of the Bell during gathering time.
villager_decorum.settings.bed_radius.too: How far from their Bed Villagers look for Cushions. From 1 to 16 blocks.
villager_decorum.settings.bell_radius.to: How far from the Bell Villagers look for Cushions. From 1 to 16 blocks.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.villager_deco: Villagers sit on cushions by their workstations, beds and the bell.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.villager_: Villagers sit on cushions by their workstations, beds and the bell.
